subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
Off and on
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Off and on"** means something that happens intermittently or occasionally. (कभी-कभी)
 
 
• **Example: **He works on his project off and on, so it's taking longer to complete.
 
 
 
• **"Now and then" **refers to something that happens occasionally, similar to "off and on." (कभी-कभी)
 
 
• **Example: **We go out for dinner now and then, but usually, we eat at home.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the idiom "off and on" is best matched with "now and then".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Know something thoroughly** (किसी चीज़ को पूरी तरह से जानना): To have complete knowledge about a subject.
 
 
• **Example:** He knows the software thoroughly and can fix any issue that arises.
 
 
 
• **Remind **(याद दिलाना): To make someone remember something.
 
 
• **Example: **Please remind me to call the doctor tomorrow.
 
 
 
• **Object to** (आपत्ति करना): To express disapproval or opposition to something.
 
 
• **Example:** She objected to the proposed changes in the policy.
